segments.name: Real Estate Rental Operations
segments.description: Leases farmland and farm-related properties to farming tenants for rental income under mostly triple-net leases.
segments.evidence: Our current business strategy includes one operating segment: Real Estate Rental Operations.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay the company rent under operating leases, including reimbursements for certain property operating costs.
